move: feature cards orbit an ellipse around a core, depth-scaled and back-blurred
how: Six white feature cards revolve once around a 440x150 ellipse in the 5s loop, computed each frame by a fx.register seek function: x = cos(a)*440, y = sin(a)*150, with depth = (sin(a)+1)/2 driving scale 0.8 -> 1.3, opacity 0.45 -> 1, zIndex and filter blur 2.2px -> 0 so cards at the back are small, dim and soft and cards passing the front are large and sharp. Eight small dots counter-rotate twice on an inner 230x78 ellipse with the same depth scaling; the core gradient disc pulses scale +-4% at twice the orbit rate and rotates 18deg/s; two dashed SVG ellipses crawl their stroke-dashoffset in opposite directions. Because everything is a function of t/D with whole-number cycles, the last frame equals the first.
adapt: Replace the six feature names and icon colours, the core gradient and label, the ellipse radii RX/RY and the dot count. Keep the one-orbit-per-loop rule and the depth formulas so the loop stays seamless.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the ring SVG, core, cards and dots from shot.features; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one tween of duration D whose onUpdate runs the seek(t) body (t = progress*D) applying gsap.set to every card and dot, since the source is a fx.register seek loop rather than a timeline. Scope document.querySelector('.core') and the orb ids to el.
caveats: per-frame filter blur on six cards
uses fx.register seek loop, not a GSAP timeline
